title: Preview image is not download image: partially suspend by model, batch, and OS while preserving usable paths
source_scope: Cross-platform promotion and image delivery interaction using wallpapers; synthesis of all models, files, tests, and subsequent revisions.
task:
English edition: all material is rendered in English, and all text you author must be in English. Chinese/English language labels identify the original source-language objects; keep those objects and their separate maintenance obligations distinct. Original language tags are provenance, not an instruction to answer in Chinese. Completion deadlines are inclusive: finishing exactly at the stated cutoff is on time. A prohibition on acting before an effective time still forbids early action.

Maintain wallpaper pack specifications up to t55. Synchronize body text, pinned notice, and old recommendations before t15, distinguishing complete files, previews, and device adaptations. Verify known conditions of reader R and prepare bounded download recommendations before t23; correct retest changes before t34, unknown systems may be conditionalized before inquiring, complete valid recommendations and preparation records based on supplements before t45. Must not treat unknown as failure or expand partial suspension into full-model deprecation, finally handoff.
authorization: May maintain own explanations and private recommendation packs, ask readers about device conditions; no tools to actually send files or operate devices. All technical facts are based on sandbox materials.

resources.title: main
resources.text: Wallpaper pack is universal for all phones, choose P/F_crop freely, just auto-fill on M2.

resources.title: pin
resources.text: Download recommendation: use F_crop directly for both M1/M2.

resources.title: tests
resources.text: Actual test sheet t=-3: P is original size for flat screen M1; F is full image for folding screen M2 inner screen, requires manual adaptation, does not guarantee auto-fill. F_crop is a preview cropped for promotion, cannot be used as full download image. M2 is divided into R/S batches, OS 10/11 both have independent test records, currently all four combinations in this table pass manual F.

resources.title: poster
resources.text: Distribution display page uploaded at t=-1: labeled 'Universal auto-fit for all phones'. Footnote indicates continued use of t=-20 preview screenshot F_crop, did not adopt current full pack or retests; not a download specification sheet.

resources.title: reader
resources.text: On my M2, the image always gets cropped on one side, you said earlier that all can be used automatically, is batch R the same?

resources.title: old_reply
resources.text: For all M2, just use F_crop automatically.

resources.title: pack
resources.text: Download recommendations prepared for reader R, not actual file transfers

resources.title: Partial compatibility revision for batch R
resources.text: t25 retest revision: Only M2's batch R + system 10 will crop edges even with F manual adaptation, and recommendations for this combination should be paused; batch R + system 11 and batch S + system 10/11 can still use F manual adaptation, and M1 is still P. Please update old recommendations according to known conditions before t34; when the system is unknown, you may first give a conditional pause and verify, and you must not guess the system.
